RagShortTexts: Under Haakon IV, the House of Sverre pacified civil strife, projecting maritime hegemony.

Variants.Content: Rising from the rustic Birkebeiner rebellion, King Haakon IV ushered in Norway's medieval golden age. From the massive stone hall at Bergen, Sverre fleets projected undeniable naval supremacy over the Hebrides, Iceland, and Greenland settlements.
Equipped for stormy northern waters, royal leidang levies assembled formidable oceanic longships with lethal archery contingents.
